intent.purpose: slideshow value frame with no person: Sunday meal prep
intent.scene_concept: high-angle phone photo of a cluttered home kitchen counter with meal-prep containers being filled
must_stay_true: no people, hands or body parts
one handwritten masking-tape label reading exactly 'MON'

subject.description: five glass meal-prep containers half filled with rice, chicken thighs and green beans
subject.pose: containers in an uneven row, lids stacked to one side

foreground: containers on a speckled laminate counter
a strip of masking tape on the first lid with 'MON' written in black marker
background: a frying pan with leftover oil on the hob
rice cooker with its lid open and steam
a supermarket bag with a real store logo
environment.clutter: high: spilled rice grains, a used fork, a crumpled paper towel

camera.position: held above the counter pointing down at about 60 degrees

composition.framing: counter fills the frame, hob at the top edge
composition.crop: the last container cut by the right edge

lighting.quality: mixed, soft with a warm hotspot under the hood

imperfections: steam haze over the rice cooker
blown highlight on the glass lids

texture.surfaces: glass with condensation, speckled laminate, brushed steel, crumpled paper

physics: containers sit flat, food heaps settle naturally
steam rises from the rice cooker only
geometry.reflections: glass lids reflect the window as soft bright shapes
geometry.perspective: high-angle perspective with converging counter edges

typography.scene_text: exactly one readable text: the handwritten word 'MON' on masking tape, uneven black marker capitals; supermarket-bag logo and soy-sauce label as printed on the real products

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding on the supermarket bag, soy sauce and rice cooker; spell any real brand correctly or keep it partly turned away

exclusions: no people, hands or body parts
no misspelled or garbled label text
no food-magazine styling, garnish or clean surfaces
no shallow depth of field or bokeh
